section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the key findings and implications of the present research, which aimed to disentangle the effects of achievement orientation and goal-setting approaches on trainees' self-regulatory activity during complex skill acquisition. The research examined the independent and integrated effects of three training design factors (goal frame, goal content, and goal proximity) on learners' self-regulatory activities, facilitating theory building and guiding future intervention design.
